content: {"like":["Values high-quality, detailed visual and audio presentation; appreciates clear, crisp images and good shadow detail; enjoys well-crafted, entertaining films with strong performances and subtle storytelling; prefers versions that enhance the original theatrical experience; appreciates thoughtful, humane humor and well-produced British comedies."],"dislike":["Dislikes soft or low-resolution imagery; finds low light or cheap filmstock problematic; is critical of underwhelming upgrades or blown-up footage; is frustrated by missing or degraded audio tracks, especially lack of 5.1/Atmos sound; dislikes forced or artificial storytelling elements and poor dubbing quality."]}
